data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate has applied a similar approach at the current year end to that applied at the previous year end in establishing the technical provisions for claims outstanding reserves and the reinsurers' share thereof. Included within net outstanding claims of USD 309.8m (2017: USD 260.3m) is a decrease in outstanding claims relating to 2017 and prior years of account of USD 18.3m (2017: increase in outstanding claims relating to 2016 and prior years of account USD 50.3m).

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2018 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding was USD 406.408m. The report discloses a net decrease in outstanding claims relating to 2017 and prior years of account of USD 18.3m (a net release). The report does not explicitly state a single aggregate GROSS prior-year movement figure; the only explicit prior-year movement sentence quotes a NET decrease of USD 18.3m. The report cites a high frequency of catastrophe events in the year (notably Hurricanes Michael and Florence and California Wildfires) and an increase in frequency of large individual losses as the main drivers of the year's claims experience.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net outstanding claims of USD 309.8m (2017: USD 260.3m) is a decrease in outstanding claims relating to 2017 and prior years of account of USD 18.3m (2017: increase in outstanding claims relating to 2016 and prior years of account USD 50.3m).

This primarily resulted from the high frequency of catastrophe events experienced in the year, specifically hurricanes Michael and Florence as well as another year of devastating California Wildfires but also an increase in frequency of large individual losses.
data.data_quality_notes: The report explicitly provides a NET prior-year release of USD 18.3m (page 20). The report does not provide an explicit GROSS aggregate prior-year movement figure in the 'movement in prior year provision' format. A gross claims development triangle is present (page 27) but the scanned images make accurate extraction of all triangle cell values error-prone; therefore a reliable aggregate GROSS prior-year development number could not be computed with high confidence from the available images. Opening gross claims outstanding (31 Dec 2017) was located as USD 406,408k (i.e. 406.408m). Gross premiums and premium mix were extracted from the divisional summary (page 4).
